The present application under Section 439 Cr.P.C has been filed on behalf of the applicant seeking
interim bail on medical grounds in Fir No. 404/2022 registered at P.S. Ranhola, Delhi for the
offences punishable under Sections 420/467/468/506/509/120B Ipc.
2.
Medical status report of the applicant was called from the Jail Superintendent.

The Report dated 11.06.2024 authored by Medical Officer In-charge, Central Jail Disp. 8/9, Tihar, New Delhi- 110064 has been filed which records as under:
"
As per jail records, inmate patient is lodged in G-8/9 since 02.08.2023.

As per available medical records, the inmate patient is a known case of type II diabetes mellitus, hypertension, coronary artery disease status post PICA stent placement in 2014-2015 with EF 15% to 20%, DSPN, DKD stage II and is under treatment from SJH This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 12/06/2024 at 20:47:15 (Endocrinology and Cardiology Department),
DDUH, and jail visiting Senior Resident Medicine, Senior Resident Ophtha and doctor on duty at G-8/9 Dispensary.

entities.text: Rishi Lal ... vs State Of Nct Of Delhi & Anr
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 The inmate patient came with complaint of chest pain, shortness of breath, and dyspnea on exertion in Jail OPD of CJ-8/9 and he was examined by doctor on duty and found blood sugar 578 mg/dL and blood pressure 158/90 mmHg here managed with IV insulin and other emergency injections, but the patient did not get any relief and was later referred to DDUH in emergency on 05.06.2024 where was examined by doctor on duty and found to have blood pressure of 180/90 mmHg and blood sugar of 369 mg/dL.
At DDUH again emergency injections including insulin was provided and after stabilizing the patient was referred by DDUH to get opinion from higher centres such as RML/AIIMS/SJH/GBPH.

Thereafter, the patient was admitted in G-8/9 M.I. Room and under supervision of duty doctor and nursing officer, all medicines and insulin were given, but it was found that blood sugar levels are still at higher side."
3. In view thereof, the present application is allowed.

The applicant is directed to be released on interim bail a period of 30 days from the date of his release , on his furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with one surety of like amount, to the satisfaction of the learned Trial Court/Link Court, further subject to following conditions:
i.
The applicant shall not leave India without prior permission of the learned Trial Court.
ii. The applicant shall intimate the learned Trial Court by way of an affidavit and to the Investigating Officer regarding any change in residential address.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the learned Trial Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing.
iv. The applicant is directed to give his mobile number to the Investigating Officer and keep it operational at all times.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 12/06/2024 at 20:47:15 v.

The applicant shall not, directly or indirectly,
tamper with evidence or try to influence the witness in any manner.
4. The application is partly allowed and disposed of accordingly.
5. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.
6. Copy of the order be sent to the concerned Jail Superintendent for necessary information and compliance.
